title: Tenazas MCP v2 producer configuration
$comment: Sanitized JSON feeds only. configured_sources is normative for URL parsing, bounds and strict integer checks. No source mappings or real source service host/port are supplied.

ttl_seconds.$comment: Use explicit 300. Runtime rejects booleans and floating-point JSON literals, even integral floats.

timeout_seconds.$comment: Use explicit 5. Must be finite; booleans rejected.

source_url.$comment: Runtime additionally requires hostname, no username/password/query/fragment and port 1..65535 if specified. Ollama is a base URL; /api/tags and /api/ps are appended.
